messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

We need to compute speed after first 10 seconds given distance 120 m starting from rest. We can assume constant acceleration? The problem says "一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離" It doesn't explicitly say constant acceleration, but likely yes. So we can compute acceleration a = 2s / t^2? Actually distance s = 0.5 a t^2. So a = 2s / t^2 = 2*120 / 100 = 240/100 = 2.4 m/s^2. Final speed v = a t = 2.4*10 = 24 m/s. That matches "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" Wait they say "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" Actually they say "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" So final speed after second stage is twice the speed from first part. But they also say "在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" Wait confusion: They say "在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" So after first part, speed is 24 m/s. Then second stage: accelerate 5 seconds from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed? Wait "初始速度" maybe refers to initial speed of second stage? They say "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" So initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s, final speed is twice that: 24 m/s. But that would mean final speed same as first part? But earlier they said final speed is twice the speed from first part. Contradiction. Let's parse Chinese: "在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？"

It might be: After reaching that speed (the speed from first part), the car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, from 12 m/s to a final speed that is twice the initial speed. The final speed is twice the speed calculated in the first part. So initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s, final speed is twice the speed from first part (which is 24 m/s). So final speed = 2 * 24 = 48 m/s. But that would be 48 m/s, which is twice the speed from first part. But initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s. So acceleration over 5 seconds from 12 to 48 m/s. That seems plausible.

But the phrase "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" indicates final speed = 2 * v_first = 48 m/s. So second stage acceleration a2 = (v_final - v_initial)/t = (48-12)/5 = 36/5 = 7.2 m/s^2.
